name: buildbase
description: Expert guide for BuildBase (@buildbase/sdk), for two audiences: developers integrating the SDK into an app - auth, workspaces, billing, feature flags, quota, credits, notifications, devices and sessions, server-side usage, webhooks, using BuildBase from any backend language over raw HTTP, and making the app MCP/agent-ready; and org owners driving the console by API key - API roles, the admin REST API, and acting for an app user via token exchange.
